test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

He requested him to wait there till he returned.

options.text: “Till he returns, please wait here,” he requested.
He said to him, “Please wait here till I return.”
He asked him to wait here till he returns.
“Wait here till I return please!” he ordered.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in **indirect speech**. There is only **one subject**, and **'that' **is not present as a linker.
 
• **'to' **indicates that the sentence is** an imperative sentence** directed towards making a request.
 
• The process of changing an indirect speech to direct speech is as follows:
 
• In this scenario, there's a request being made. Hence, the sentence is adjusted to reflect a polite request in direct speech.
 
• The reporting verb **'requested' **indicates that the sentence should be converted into a polite request in direct speech.
 
• **'to wait there till he returned'** is the action being requested. In direct speech, this becomes more personalized with specific pronouns reflecting the original speaker and listener** ("Please wait here till I return").**
 
• After reporting speech there will be a **comma (,)** and the reported speech will come under a **double inverted comma (“….”).**

Therefore, the correct direct speech is ***"He said to him, 'Please wait here till I return.'”***
